info.name: Depreciation Entries
info.description:
# Depreciation Entries API

Branch-scoped CRUD for `depreciation_entry` and `depreciation_entry_item`. Uses `cost_center_id` to select the clinic database.

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Query/body: `token`, `requester` (required on all endpoints)

## Cost center (branch) IDs
| cost_center_id | Clinic |
|----------------|--------|
| 1 | Mobile |
| 2 | Oakridge |
| 3 | Mactan |
| 4 | Consolacion |
| 7 | Mantlewood |

## Parent fields
- `accounts_payable_voucher_id` — optional; when sent, must exist on the same branch DB

## Item fields (kept alongside existing journal-style fields)
- Existing: `asset_id`, `account_type_id`, `cost_center_id`, `debit`, `credit`, `remarks`
- New: `useful_life_months`, `start_date`, `debit_account_type_id`, `credit_account_type_id`, `amount` (price), `serial_number`, `asset_tag_number`
- `end_date` is **computed server-side** from `start_date + useful_life_months`; do not submit it
- When `amount` is sent and `debit`/`credit` are empty, both default to `amount` for parent totals

## Asset from receipt note (no asset_id)
If `asset_id` is omitted, send `name` and `item_id` (receipt-note catalog item). The API reuses a branch `asset` with the same `item_id`, or inserts one on **this clinic DB only** (not synced to other branches). Run `sql/asset_item_id.sql` first. See `docs/depreciation_assets.md`.

## Status
Update blocked when status is `approved`. Use `change_status` for `approved` / `disapproved`.

## Asset depreciation report
`GET /depreciation_entries/get_asset_depreciation_report` — manager view per item with computed monthly/accumulated/NBV as of `as_of_date`.

## Request body format
- **GET** — query params
- **POST** — multipart form-data (`items` as JSON string in form field)

request.description:
## GET `/depreciation_entries/get`

List depreciation entries for a cost center. Each row includes nested `items` with account type names and computed `end_date`.

## GET `/depreciation_entries/get_asset_depreciation_report`

Manager view: one row per `depreciation_entry_item` as of `as_of_date` (default today).

### Formulas
- Monthly depreciation = acquisition cost ÷ useful life (months)
- Months elapsed = TIMESTAMPDIFF from `start_date` to `as_of_date`, min 0, capped at useful life
- Accumulated depreciation = FLOOR(monthly × months elapsed), capped at acquisition cost
- Net book value = acquisition cost − accumulated depreciation

### Manager columns
`asset_name`, `supplier_name`, `acquisition_cost`, `useful_life_months`, `monthly_depreciation`, `accumulated_depreciation`, `net_book_value`

`supplier_name` comes from `accounts_payable_voucher_id` → receipt note (`type=receipt_note`) → `receipt_note.supplier_id` → master `supplier.name`. Null when there is no APV, the APV is not a receipt note, or the supplier is missing.

### Tracing columns
`depreciation_entry_item_id`, `depreciation_entry_id`, `asset_id`, `serial_number`, `asset_tag_number`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `months_elapsed`, `as_of_date`, `cost_center_id`, `accounts_payable_voucher_id`, `supplier_name`, `status`, debit/credit account type id and name

formdata.description: Optional; must exist on branch DB
JSON array. Omit asset_id and send name + item_id to create/reuse a branch-local asset. Or send asset_id if it already exists.

request.description:
## POST `/depreciation_entries/create`

Requires `cost_center_id`. Optional `accounts_payable_voucher_id`. Item `amount` defaults debit/credit when those are omitted.

Each item must have `asset_id`, **or** `name` + `item_id` (receipt note). Missing `asset_id` reuses a branch asset with that `item_id` or inserts one on this clinic DB only.

## POST `/depreciation_entries/update`

Requires `cost_center_id` and `depreciation_entry_id`. Cannot update when status is `approved`. Items omitted from payload are soft-deleted.

New lines without `asset_id` need `name` + `item_id`. Existing lines that already have `asset_id` do not.
